```{r setup, include=F}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(dplyr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
```


## Data

```{r data}
al <- read.csv("alluvial_plot_data.csv",
               header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
               na.strings = c("", NA))

# shorten long label for display
al$Level_1[al$Level_1 == "met.-prop. complex"] <- "mp complex"

# preserve CSV row order – Level_1_sort defines the left-to-right ordering
# (a. cranium … p. female genitalia)
al$Level_1 <- factor(al$Level_1, levels = al$Level_1)
al$Level_2 <- factor(al$Level_2, levels = unique(al$Level_2))
al$Level_3 <- factor(al$Level_3, levels = unique(al$Level_3))
```


## Colour palette

```{r palette}
# muted Nature-quality palette: one colour per body group + charcoal for top level
# Level_2 values in CSV: head, wing, mesosoma, leg, metasoma
# Level_3 value in CSV:  body
group_pal <- c(
  "head"     = "#4e79a7",   # slate blue
  "wing"     = "#b07aa1",   # muted purple
  "mesosoma" = "#59a14f",   # forest green
  "leg"      = "#f28e2b",   # amber
  "metasoma" = "#e15759",   # coral red
  "body"     = "#2d2d2d"    # dark charcoal
)

# each region inherits the colour of its parent group
region_pal <- setNames(
  group_pal[as.character(al$Level_2)],
  as.character(al$Level_1)
)

# unified palette: covers all stratum labels and alluvium fill values
all_pal <- c(group_pal, region_pal)
```


## Alluvial plot

Flow widths are proportional to `Level_1_nstates` (number of character states
per anatomical region).

```{r alluvial-plot, fig.height = 14, fig.width = 8}
ggplot(
  al,
  aes(
    y     = Level_1_nstates,
    axis1 = Level_1,          # bottom level  (15 anatomical regions)
    axis2 = Level_2,          # middle level  (5 body groups)
    axis3 = Level_3           # top level     (body)
  )
) +

  # ── alluvial flows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = Level_2),
    width    = 1/3,
    alpha    = 0.75,
    color    = NA,
    knot.pos = 0.4
  ) +

  # ── stratum boxes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_stratum(
    aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
    width     = 1/3,
    color     = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # ── stratum labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  geom_text(
    stat      = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    angle     = 90,
    size      = 2.8,
    color     = "white",
    fontface  = "bold"
  ) +

  # ── vertical flow: body (top) → groups (middle) → regions (bottom) ────────
  coord_flip() +

  # ── colour scales ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_pal, guide = "none") +

  # ── labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    title = "Hierarchical anatomy of adult Hymenoptera"
  ) +

  # ── theme (Nature-ready: no grid, no axis text) ───────────────────────────
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    axis.text   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
    plot.title  = element_text(
      hjust  = 0.5,
      face   = "bold",
      size   = 14,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 30, 15, 30)
  )
```

```{r export, eval=FALSE}
ggsave(
```
